page.heading: About this browser
page.introPurpose: Find where to publish, what a deal covers, and what it costs.
page.introLegacy: It is a modernisation of the <link>WUR journal browser</link>, rebuilt on fully open data and released as open source. You can self-host it.
page.introPolicy: For open access policy questions, use the library links under Contact below.

degraded.title: Some data sources are currently degraded

freshness.heading: Data freshness
freshness.intro: Each row shows when a data source last refreshed successfully, how often that should happen, and whether the source is up to date.
freshness.tableCaption: Data sources of this institution and those shared by every institution, with what each provides, when each last refreshed, how often each is expected to refresh, and whether each is up to date
freshness.noRuns: No refresh has been recorded for this institution yet.
freshness.footnote: Nightly sources may run half a day late and weekly sources one day before they count as overdue. Sources marked by hand are refreshed when the library runs the job, so they are never overdue.

rows.pure: Publication counts per journal from the institution's research information system. This is the primary figure, and OpenAlex cross-checks it.
rows.openalex-stats: Publication counts per journal from OpenAlex. They cross-check the counts from the research information system.
rows.openalex-works: The institution's publications as OpenAlex records them, with open access status and citation counts.
rows.crossref: DOI metadata used to match institutional works to their journal.
rows.openaire: Alternative records and open access links for individual institutional works.
rows.openalex-authors: Links between the institution's authors and their publications.
rows.authors: The institution's author records, built on this server from the other sources.
rows.openalex-journals: Journal records, open access status, and citation metrics.
rows.openalex-oa: The open access colour of each journal, counted from its publications.
rows.openaccess-nl: Deal terms, conditions, and workflow descriptions.
rows.jct: Journal lists for transformative agreements, one input to the deal register.
rows.openapc: APC price aggregates and per-article cost evidence.
rows.doaj: The authoritative registry for gold and diamond open access. Whether a journal charges an APC decides gold versus diamond, and the journal URL from DOAJ is the canon homepage. The harvest reads DOAJ's full journal CSV.
rows.jisc-policies: Policies for green open access, also called self-archiving. They say which article version a publisher allows to be archived where, and under which licence and embargo.
rows.scimago: SJR indicator, best quartile, and SJR h-index.
rows.ror: Research Organization Registry (CC0): canonical names, aliases, organisation types, hierarchies, and map coordinates for collaboration partners.

freshness.statsWindow: Publication statistics cover works published in {window} or later. The search lists journals with more than 3 publications in that window.

privacy.note: Privacy on this page: your browser loads everything on this site from this server. The one exception is the collaboration map, which loads its background map tiles directly from OpenFreeMap (tiles.openfreemap.org); your browser contacts that service whenever a map is shown.

harvests.heading: Harvest runs
harvests.tableCaption: Most recent harvest runs per source, entity, and filter set, with status and finish time
harvests.footnote: Rows for deal sources are historical. The deal register has been maintained by hand since October 2026.
